jobs.title: Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Proficiency with both legacy and modern data technologies. Strong foundation in data governance, quality, integration, and analytics.
Integration platform and modernization expertise: Experience leading the transformation of legacy integration infrastructure to modern architectures. Deep understanding of API-first design, event-driven systems, and hybrid technology ecosystems
Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Nice to Have

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation, commissions, and stock where applicable
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
A world-class training program in financial services
Opportunities to take on progressively greater accountabilities.

jobs.description:
Location:
Toronto, Canada
Salary:
up to $250,000, dependent on experience
Employment:
Permanent | Full-time
Industry:
Legal & Professional Services

Ingenio is supporting a leading international law firm with the appointment of a Global Head of Digital Strategy & Transformation
.

This is a senior leadership position reporting directly to the Global Chief Operating Officer, with significant exposure to the Board and wider executive leadership team. The successful candidate will lead the firm's digital transformation strategy, bringing together business applications, data, AI, automation and digital client services to deliver measurable business improvements.

This is not a traditional IT infrastructure or operational technology role. An established CTO is responsible for those areas. The focus of this appointment is on strategy, development, transformation and execution
.

The Opportunity
You will take responsibility for developing and delivering a global digital transformation strategy across legal, corporate and trust services. Working with senior business stakeholders, you will turn commercial and operational challenges into practical technology solutions that improve efficiency, client experience and service delivery.

You'll inherit an established application development team and will be responsible for developing its capabilities as the transformation programme progresses.

Significant projects are already underway, including a major entity-management platform initiative, a broader data management and analytics programme, and opportunities to extend the use of AI and automation across the business.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and deliver a global digital strategy and transformation roadmap aligned with business priorities.
Lead and develop the existing Business Technology and Application Development team.
Own the business applications roadmap, including entity management and client-facing technology solutions.
Oversee the design, development and delivery of new systems, whether built internally, purchased or delivered through external partners.
Drive the data strategy, analytics, reporting and business intelligence agenda.
Identify and implement practical AI and automation opportunities across legal and professional services.

What We're Looking For
We are particularly interested in senior digital transformation and business technology leaders from professional services, legal, fiduciary/corporate services, financial services or similarly complex, regulated environments
.

You will bring:
Significant experience leading digital strategy, business technology or enterprise transformation.
A proven track record of delivering complex technology programmes with measurable business outcomes.
Strong experience across business applications, software development and technology-enabled process improvement.
A solid understanding of data strategy, analytics, business intelligence, AI and automation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams and managing external delivery partners.
The ability to influence Board-level stakeholders while remaining technically credible and close to delivery.

Location & Package
Toronto is the mandatory location, with this being an in-office role.

Interested?
This is an opportunity to shape the digital direction of an established international professional services organisation, with direct access to senior leadership, an existing development capability and significant transformation programmes already underway.

For a confidential discussion, please contact Michelle Queally at Ingenio
, or apply directly.

jobs.title: Director of Product — SafeSend (Gather & Deliver)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Accounting firms are reinventing how they prepare tax returns, and their clients, taxpayers expect a simple, secure, digital way to hand over documents and get a finished return. Firms expect everything in between to be faster, more automated, and connected to the tools they already run. SafeSend is where that happens: the taxpayer-facing perimeter and engine of Tax Workflow for accounting firm clients, the surface taxpayers touch, and, through its APIs, the engine firms build their own workflows on.

As Director of Product for SafeSend, you will own that surface and lead its evolution into an AI-driven, agentic gather-prepare-deliver experience on Thomson Reuters’ CoCounsel platform and open it up so firms and partners can build on it.

The Opportunity

Firms are consolidating fragmented point tools into one connected workflow and want a single partner to deliver it.
Taxpayers expect a modern, mobile, trustworthy way to share documents and receive their return.
Document data extraction is going AI-native; firms want agentic preparation and review and are adopting it now.
Firms increasingly want to build on open APIs so their own portals, data and reporting stay connected as the market converges.
SafeSend sits at the center of all four. This is a build-and-converge mandate — shaping a market-defining product, not maintaining a mature one.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver SafeSend. Own the SafeSend portfolio end to end — Gather, Organizers, e-Sign, Delivery, Returns and Extensions — season over season, at the reliability and scale that tax-filing peaks demand.
Converge SafeSend and TaxCaddy. Bring the best of SafeSend and TaxCaddy together into one Gather & Deliver experience for every firm and taxpayer
Componentize the portfolio. Turn each part of SafeSend into reusable workflow components that can be recomposed across the gather – prepare – deliver flow and used across the broader CoCounsel platform, rather than locked inside a single app.
Enable expanded SafeSend access via APIs and orchestration. Expand the SafeSend API surface — open APIs, events and integrations — as a first-class capability, so firms and partners embed SafeSend in their own portals and workflows and keep their tools, data and reporting connected, with orchestration so AI agents and partner systems can coordinate gather and delivery programmatically.
Deliver agentic Gather & Deliver through CoCounsel. Bring agentic Gather — and AI-driven extraction, preparation and review — into the SafeSend experience on the CoCounsel platform, so more of the work shifts from staff to the platform while the firm stays in control.

What Success Looks Like

Firms experience one connected Gather & Deliver workflow, whatever ecosystem they run today.
The SafeSend API is something firms and partners actively build on, not a bespoke integration project.
Firms reach AI-driven, agentic preparation and review through SafeSend, season over season.
Taxpayers get a simpler, faster, more trustworthy experience — and firms see measurably less manual work.

Required Qualifications

8+ years in product management, including leading a product line at scale as a Director or senior PM.
Experience building and productizing platform, API or developer-facing products — not only features on top of them.
A track record of converging or migrating products without disrupting existing customers.
Fluency with AI-native products (data extraction, agents, orchestration) and comfort partnering with a platform team.
Strong systems thinking — able to see a portfolio as composable components rather than a monolith.
Experience in the tax & accounting workflow space strongly preferred
Strong stakeholder management and a proven record of building high-performing teams

Preferred Qualifications

Background in tax & accounting, fintech, or document / data-processing workflows.
Experience partnering with large, demanding enterprise customers as design partners.
Comfort owning commercially consequential product decisions.
Advanced business or technical degree preferred

This posting is for proactive recruitment purposes and may be used to fill current openings or future vacancies within our organization.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

Our use of AI within the recruitment process Thomson Reuters utilizes Artificial Intelligence (AI) to support parts of our global recruitment process. Unless you opt-out, our AI system will assess the information provided by you and compare it to the requirements listed for the role, and present the result to our recruitment personnel for further review. The AI system acts as a supporting tool, but there is always a human making the decision if you will be considered for the role.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $181,400 USD - $337,000 USD. For any eligible US locations, unless otherwise noted, the base compensation range for this role is $157,500 USD - $292,500 USD. For Ontario, Canada, the base compensation range for this role is $172,000 CAD - $222,000 CAD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

About Us

Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.

We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.

As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug-free workplace.

Thomson Reuters makes reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities, including veterans with disabilities, and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. If you reside in the United States and require an accommodation in the recruiting process, you may contact our Human Resources Department at HR.Leave-Expert@thomsonreuters.com. Disability accommodations in the recruiting process may include things like a sign language interpreter, making interview rooms accessible, providing assistive technology, or other relevant accommodations. Please note this email is not intended for general recruitment questions and we will promptly respond to inquiries regarding accommodations. More information on requesting an accommodation here.

Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.

More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com

jobs.title: Director of Operations, Prairies
jobs.description:
This position is based out of Alberta and will involve extensive travel throughout the Prairies Region.

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in over 370 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. With that growth, is a vision to be the most innovative healthcare providers in community rehabilitation, workplace health and wellness and medical assessment services. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

Job Overview:

We are in search of an experienced Director of Operations who will be instrumental in steering our operational activities across multiple clinics in the Prairies region (Saskatchewan, Manitoba and Alberta). The Director of Operations will report directly into the VP, Clinic Operations and will be responsible for the leadership and management of our Regional Directors of Operations, instilling a culture of operational excellence and inclusivity. This pivotal role plays an integral part in maintaining exemplary patient care standards, driving revenue and EBITDA growth, and creating an attractive environment for top clinical talent.

Key Responsibilities:

Provide leadership to the Regional Directors of Operations, ensuring a consistent, high-quality patient care experience across all clinics.
Develop and implement strategic plans and operational objectives in alignment with Lifemark's overarching goals and mission.
Foster a culture of inclusivity at the clinic level through the Regional Directors of Operations, promoting engagement and a sense of belonging among staff.
Drive a culture of taking an interdisciplinary approach at the clinic level through the Regional Directors of Operations, promoting a holistic approach to patient care.
Drive revenue and EBITDA growth by utilizing data to make informed decisions and drive operational improvements.
Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders, positioning Lifemark as a preferred choice for top clinical talent and possible new acquisitions.
Ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements to uphold Lifemark's esteemed reputation.
Efficiently manage operational budgets, optimizing resource allocation to achieve operational and financial targets and accountable to the results of their area.
Drive Lifemark’s key KPIs and accountable to the results of their area.

Qualifications:

Bachelors Degree in Kinesiology, Physiotherapy, Business, Healthcare Administration or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
Minimum of 7-10 years of senior management experience, with a proven track record in leading sizable teams within healthcare environment.
Demonstrated success in operational management, strategic planning, and driving revenue and EBITDA growth.
Outstanding leadership skills with a commitment to fostering inclusive work environments.
Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

Inclusion

Lifemark welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Lifemark promotes equal employment opportunities for all job applicants, including those self-identifying as a member of the following groups: Indigenous peoples, Newcomers to Canada, and Visible minorities.

Accommodation

Accommodations are available on request for all candidates taking part in any aspect of the recruitment and selection process. Email us at talent
at lifemark.ca

jobs.title: Vice President ACU Wealth
jobs.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

Vice President, ACU Wealth

Reporting to the Chief Retail & Wealth Officer, the Vice President, ACU Wealth is a member of the senior leadership team, is responsible for contributing to the development of strategies and for the development and execution of operational and business plans which support Assiniboine Credit Union / Caisse Assiniboine (ACU) in achieving its strategic goals, vision, mission, purpose and are aligned with ACU’s values. This includes associated Wealth subsidiary(ies) of ACU.
As a senior leader, this role is key to supporting ACU’s commitment to rural and agricultural communities, francophone services and values-based banking and ACU’s triple bottom line accountability to people, planet and prosperity.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Leadership

Lead, develop and mentor high-performing teams to achieve and exceed expectations while coaching employees to realize their professional development goals.
Engage with purpose, lead by example, provide feedback, coach, commit to regular one-on-ones and team meetings.
Develop effective working relationships with internal partners across all departments, acting as One Assiniboine to achieve strategic goals.
Maintain overall department service levels and standards, ensuring team capabilities support the delivery and execution of strategic and operational plans.
Actively demonstrates commitment to continuous improvement.
In partnership with the Chief Officer, act as a support resource to ACU’s Board of Directors and/or Committees of the Board, undertaking reviews, developing reports, recommendations and policies for Board/Committee consideration.
Champion ACU’s commitment to rural and agricultural communities, francophone services, values-based banking, respectful workplace and diversity, equity and inclusion.
Act as an ambassador of ACU by being visible in the organization and the community in support of corporate and community initiatives.
Identify and leverage opportunities to engage in the promotion of ACU products and services.

Merger Leadership

Foster employee engagement through regular and effective communication, championing change, positively addressing employee concerns, building trust, and supporting productivity through all phases of the merger.
Serve as a visible and approachable leader, promoting shared values and a unified corporate culture, to ensure employees feel connected and valued through all phases of the merger.
Ensure that employees understand the benefits of the merger and are equipped to adapt to new and/or changing policies, procedures, processes, systems, and structures. Identify and work to positively and collaboratively address resistance to change.

Advice & Service Delivery

Responsible for the distribution of wealth advice and service across all member segments and through a variety of channels including in-branch, virtually, and through centralized teams of Advisors.
Proactively identifies and acts upon opportunities beyond wealth advice and service; partnering with the appropriate teams including branch, agriculture, business, community, and others to solicit referrals as appropriate.
Act as a change agent to advance strategic objectives and shift the culture towards proactive advice and service delivery.
Act as a voice for the member, seeking to identify and remove member pain points, contributing to a consistent and compelling member experience.
Consistently deliver business results through the achievement of KPIs and support business partners in achieving collective success.
Leverage member survey feedback, local market data, and industry research to identify areas of opportunity to consistently improve the member experience.
Resolve escalated member complaints with urgency and encourage first point of contact complaint resolution.
Ensure needs-based and advice-based sales practices are adhered to in member interactions and the achievement of all sales objectives.
Leads the relationship with Aviso, ACU’s Investment Dealer, working in partnership on strategic and operational projects.
Working in partnership with IT, supports assigned business systems including Investment Dealer platform and other assigned systems.

Strategic, Operational and Business Planning & Execution

Contribute to the development of strategic plans, enterprise level operational planning processes, and support cross-functional project teams.
Responsible for the development and execution of annual business and operational plans in support of ACU’s strategic plan.
Own the annual departmental budget process, manage expenses within budget including all capital, operating and personnel expenditures.
Implement workforce plans aligning resources based on member needs and preferences and using data to inform decisions.
Responsible for the development, maintenance and quality of all partner, supplier and vendor relationships associated with the position.
Keep well informed of financial services industry trends and local market conditions and other relevant matters to inform strategic, operational and business planning.

Regulation & Compliance

Accountable for the development, implementation and ongoing review of relevant management policies and procedures.
Accountable for ensuring the team follows all corporate policies and procedures and reporting is completed as required.
Accountable for team adherence to all compliance, risk management, regulatory and legislative requirements for all aspects of the Wealth operation at ACU and its Wealth subsidiary(ies).
Support internal and external auditors and/or regulators in the completion of regular and special reviews and audits and ensure accountability to resulting action plans.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

This position requires a related degree plus ten years of cross-functional experience with a minimum five years in management or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Financial services sector experience, experience coaching successful sales teams, and a Financial Planning Designation is required.
Advanced reading, writing and oral skills in both official languages, English and French, are preferred.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILL & ABILITY (KSA) PROFILE

This role requires success demonstrated in all ACU’s core competency areas including:
Leading Self
Member Service
Delivering Results
Communication
Change
Team Leadership
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Organizational Acumen

In addition, the Vice President, ACU Wealth:

Is energetic, authentic, passionate, motivated and strategic.
Is described by others as clear, focused and driven.
Doesn’t shy away from challenging conversations.
Is excited to introduce and champion innovative and progressive approaches, processes, tools and systems in a digital context to advice and service delivery teams.
Has a successful history of executing on plans that resulted in exceptional member or customer experiences throughout an organization.
Is dedicated to quality coaching and professional development, supporting others to be effective team leaders and people managers.
Has a successful history of executing on operational projects, plans and initiatives and track record of supporting individual and team development.
Has a good understanding of banking technology and operations practices as well as current and emerging regulatory requirements.
Applies a broad and strategic organizational perspective to thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making.
Builds strong, balanced, reciprocal cross-functional relationships irrespective of hierarchy inside ACU and builds mutually valuable networks outside ACU and the credit union system.
Operates at the highest standard of ethical behavior as a leader by example.

Bâtissez la fonction finance de demain.

Certains postes en finance consistent à maintenir ce qui existe déjà.

Celui-ci consiste à bâtir ce qui vient ensuite.

Nous recherchons un(e) directeur(trice) des finances d'exception, qui allie une grande rigueur financière à un instinct naturel pour améliorer le fonctionnement des entreprises.

Il ne s'agit pas simplement d'un poste axé sur la production de rapports financiers. C'est une occasion de prendre en charge une fonction finance, de remettre en question les processus existants, de mettre en place de meilleurs systèmes et de jouer un rôle important dans l'avenir de l'entreprise.

L'opportunité

Vous aurez pour mandat de développer une fonction finance rigoureuse, efficace, évolutive et de plus en plus automatisée.

Vous aurez l'occasion d'influencer non seulement la façon dont l'information financière est produite, mais aussi la manière dont elle est utilisée pour prendre de meilleures décisions d'affaires.

Votre contribution aura un impact dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Vos responsabilités

Leadership financier : Prendre en charge la production des rapports financiers mensuels et annuels, les opérations comptables, les contrôles internes et l'exactitude de l'information financière.

Flux de trésorerie et fonds de roulement : Améliorer la visibilité sur les flux de trésorerie, les prévisions, la gestion des comptes clients et l'efficacité du fonds de roulement.

Performance de l'entreprise : Développer des analyses financières pertinentes qui permettent à la direction de mieux comprendre la rentabilité, de cerner les occasions d'amélioration et de prendre de meilleures décisions.

Systèmes et automatisation : Diriger l'amélioration des systèmes financiers, des processus, des intégrations et des capacités de production de rapports, en mettant l'accent sur l'automatisation et l'intelligence artificielle.

Leadership d'équipe : Développer une équipe des finances hautement performante, avec des responsabilités clairement définies, une exécution rigoureuse et une culture d'amélioration continue.

Partenariat stratégique : Collaborer directement avec l'équipe de direction sur la planification financière, les initiatives d'affaires importantes et la création de valeur à long terme.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes un(e) professionnel(le) accompli(e) de la finance qui va au-delà de la simple maîtrise des principes comptables.

Vous comprenez le fonctionnement d'une entreprise.

Vous Possédez

Un titre de CPA et une solide expérience en leadership financier.
Une expérience démontrée dans la direction d'une fonction finance au sein d'une entreprise en croissance dont les opérations sont complexes.
De solides compétences en information financière, comptabilité, budgétisation, prévisions financières et gestion de trésorerie.
Des réalisations concrètes en matière d'amélioration des processus financiers, d'implantation de systèmes ou d'automatisation.
La capacité de diriger des équipes, d'établir une culture de responsabilisation et d'obtenir des résultats.
Un excellent jugement d'affaires, une curiosité intellectuelle et la confiance nécessaire pour remettre en question les façons de faire établies.

Une expérience en logistique, en transport ou dans d'autres secteurs caractérisés par un volume élevé de transactions serait un atout.

Ce qui fera votre succès

Vous êtes à l'aise autant avec les détails financiers qu'avec la vision d'ensemble.

Vous n'acceptez pas les processus inefficaces simplement parce qu'ils ont toujours été faits de cette façon.

Vous cernez les problèmes, proposez des solutions concrètes et veillez à leur mise en œuvre.

Avant tout, vous prenez vos responsabilités en main.

Pourquoi Western Alliance Logistics?

Parce qu'il s'agit d'une occasion de faire une réelle différence.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec la haute direction, participerez à des décisions d'affaires importantes et contribuerez à bâtir une fonction finance tournée vers l'avenir.

Nous recherchons une personne qui aspire à plus qu'un simple titre de cadre supérieur en finance.

Nous recherchons une personne qui souhaite bâtir quelque chose d'exceptionnel.

Rémunération : Salaire de base concurrentiel selon l'expérience, auquel s'ajoutent des avantages sociaux.

Lieu de travail : Kirkland, Québec

Prêt(e) à bâtir la suite?

Faites parvenir votre CV à talent@westernalliancelogistics.com. Nous serions ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Director of Finance – Western Alliance Logistics

Build the finance function of tomorrow.

Some Finance Positions Are About Maintaining What Already Exists.

This one is about building what comes next.

Western Alliance Logistics is an established, entrepreneurial logistics company entering an important period of growth and technological transformation.

We're looking for an exceptional Director of Finance who combines strong financial discipline with an instinct for improving how businesses operate.

This is not simply a financial reporting position. It's an opportunity to take ownership of a finance function, challenge existing processes, introduce better systems and play an important role in the company's future.

The opportunity

You will have the mandate to develop a finance function that is accurate, efficient, scalable and increasingly automated.

You'll have the opportunity to influence not only how financial information is produced, but how it is used to make better business decisions.

Your impact will be felt across the organization.

What you'll own

Financial leadership: Take ownership of monthly and annual financial reporting, accounting operations, internal controls and financial accuracy.

Cash flow and working capital: Improve cash flow visibility, forecasting, receivables management and working capital efficiency.

Business performance: Build meaningful financial analysis that helps management understand profitability, identify opportunities and make better decisions.

Systems and automation: Lead improvements to financial systems, processes, integrations and reporting capabilities, with an emphasis on automation and Al.

Team leadership: Develop a high-performing finance team with clear accountability, strong execution and a culture of continuous improvement.

Strategic partnership: Work directly with the Executive team on financial planning, important business initiatives and long-term value creation.

You're an accomplished finance professional who has moved beyond simply knowing how accounting works.

You understand how a business works.

You Bring

A CPA designation and substantial experience in financial leadership.

A proven record of leading a finance function in a growing, operationally complex business.

Strong financial reporting, accounting, budgeting, forecasting and cash management capabilities.

Demonstrated success improving financial processes, implementing systems or introducing automation.

The ability to lead people, establish accountability and deliver results.

Strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity and the confidence to challenge the status quo. Experience in logistics, transportation or other transaction-intensive businesses would be valuable.

What will make you successful

You can move comfortably between financial detail and the bigger picture.

You don't accept inefficient processes simply because they've always been done that way. You identify problems, propose practical solutions and follow through.

Above all, you take ownership.

Why Western Alliance Logistics? Because this is an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

You'll work closely with senior leadership, have access to important business decisions and help build a finance organization designed for the future.

We're looking for someone who wants to do more than hold a senior finance title.

We're looking for someone who wants to build something exceptional.

Compensation: Competitive base salary commensurate with experience, plus benefits.

The successful candidate will bring deep wealth management expertise, a strong understanding of the regulatory environment, and a proven ability to attract top talent, develop leaders, and deliver strong business and client outcomes.

Strategic Leadership & Market Growth

Lead the overall strategy, performance, and growth of the market, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, market share, and client retention.
Develop and execute market growth strategies that strengthen competitive positioning and drive sustainable business results.
Identify emerging opportunities, industry trends, and market dynamics to inform strategic priorities and decision-making.
Serve as a visible leader in the community, enhancing BMO Private Wealth's profile and cultivating key client, referral, and industry relationships.
Partner across BMO to deliver an integrated wealth management experience and maximize growth opportunities.

Lead workforce planning efforts to ensure the market is positioned for continued success and scalability.

Enable advisors to deepen client relationships, grow their practices, and achieve business objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex client, advisor, and business matters.

What is the opportunity?

At RBC Insurance, AI is fundamental to transforming how we operate, serve our customers, and compete in a rapidly evolving financial services landscape. To realize this opportunity, we need a visionary leader who can simultaneously architect and enable enterprise AI capabilities, modernize and enhance our data platforms, and transform our legacy integration infrastructure into a nimble, scalable foundation.

As Senior Director, AI and Data & Integration Platforms, you will own the strategy and end-to-end delivery across all three domains. You'll be responsible for building the intelligent, data-driven foundation that enables RBC Insurance to unlock AI-driven intelligence to enhance customer experiences, and fundamentally transform our business model. This is your opportunity to lead one of the most consequential technology transformations in our organization's history.

What will you do?

Own enterprise AI strategy and delivery: Develop and execute the long-term vision for AI capabilities across RBC Insurance IT and business operations. Identify frontier, game-changing AI use cases that drive competitive advantage, serve as the expert for emerging AI technologies, and position RBC Insurance as an AI-first organization.
Architect and modernize data platforms: Lead the strategic transformation of our global data foundation, stabilizing and enhancing both on-premises and cloud data platforms. Build a scalable, secure, resilient data architecture that serves as the foundation for AI, analytics, and business intelligence. Ensure data governance, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise while optimizing cost and performance.
Transform legacy integration platforms: Champion the modernization of our integration infrastructure, moving from legacy systems to API-first, event-driven architectures. Design integration platforms that enable seamless data flow, real-time decision-making, and agile business capability delivery.
Drive strategy into delivery at scale: Translate strategic vision into executable roadmaps and quarterly milestones. Lead end-to-end execution of transformational initiatives spanning AI implementation, data platform migration, and integration modernization. Establish accountability for delivery excellence, quality, and measurable business outcomes.
Build and lead high-performing teams: Provide strategic leadership to data architects, AI engineers, integration specialists, and technical teams. Foster a high-performance culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. Coach technical leaders on strategic thinking, delivery excellence, and career development. Build a team of thought leaders who stay at the forefront of AI, data, and integration technologies.
Build strategic partnerships and stakeholder alignment: Serve as the trusted delivery partner to business leaders, IT executives, and technology teams. Cultivate strong relationships across Technology, Digital Channels, Business Operations, and Product teams. Align organizational priorities, remove obstacles, and drive speed to impact through collaborative leadership..
Champion continuous learning: Cultivate a team of technical thought leaders who stay at the forefront of industry trends, emerging technologies, and digital platform best practices, ensuring RBC Insurance maintains competitive advantage and drives innovation across digital channels.

What do you need to succeed?

Must Have

10+ years of progressive leadership in AI, data, and/or technology transformation, with 5+ years leading technical teams delivering enterprise-scale IT solutions. Demonstrated track record of executing transformational business strategy and delivering measurable organizational impact.
Deep expertise in artificial intelligence and machine learning: Proven experience architecting, implementing, and scaling AI solutions in production environments. Strong understanding of GenAI and Agentic AI applications across business operations, including predictive analytics, automation, and intelligent decision-making. Ability to translate AI capabilities into business value and organizational efficiencies.
Expert-level data platform leadership: Extensive experience designing, building, and modernizing enterprise data platforms (data lakes, data warehouses, cloud platforms). Enterprise delivery and execution excellence: Demonstrated ability to lead complex, multi-year transformational programs at enterprise scale within financial institutions or regulated industries. Strong foundation in software development lifecycle, budgeting, resource allocation, and delivery governance.
Executive leadership and stakeholder influence: Exceptional ability to lead diverse technical teams and influence senior stakeholders through data-driven decision-making, compelling communication, and strategic facilitation. Strong executive presence and ability to operate at the C-level.

Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries, with deep understanding of compliance, risk management, and enterprise governance frameworks.
Hands-on experience with specific AI/ML platforms (e.g., cloud AI services, Agentic AI, LLMs, GenAI, MCP, etc), modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), and integration technologies (e.g. Apache Kafka, APIGee, event streaming, etc).
Experience in leading AI adoption and scaling development practices. Established and/or Chaired AI Centers of Excellence that drove organizational AI adoption.
Experience leading successful data modernization programs on multi-platform hybrid environments in large enterprises.

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. Working closely with Investment Advisors, Private Wealth professionals, senior leadership, and key business partners, the VP & Market Leader develops and executes strategic growth plans, strengthens BMO Private Wealth's presence within the community, and fosters a high-performance culture built on collaboration, accountability, and inclusion.

The successful candidate will bring deep wealth management expertise, a strong understanding of the regulatory environment, and a proven ability to attract top talent, develop leaders, and deliver strong business and client outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Market Growth

Lead the overall strategy, performance, and growth of the market, with accountability for revenue growth, profitability, market share, and client retention.
Develop and execute market growth strategies that strengthen competitive positioning and drive sustainable business results.
Identify emerging opportunities, industry trends, and market dynamics to inform strategic priorities and decision-making.
Serve as a visible leader in the community, enhancing BMO Private Wealth's profile and cultivating key client, referral, and industry relationships.
Partner across BMO to deliver an integrated wealth management experience and maximize growth opportunities.

Talent Leadership & Advisor Development

Attract, recruit, retain, and develop top-performing Investment Advisors and Private Wealth professionals.
Foster a high-performance culture centered on accountability, collaboration, inclusion, and client focus.
Coach and develop leaders and advisors to support productivity, engagement, succession planning, and long-term career growth.
Lead workforce planning efforts to ensure the market is positioned for continued success and scalability.

Client Excellence

Champion an exceptional client experience and ensure the delivery of comprehensive wealth management solutions.
Enable advisors to deepen client relationships, grow their practices, and achieve business objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for complex client, advisor, and business matters.

Risk, Compliance & Operational Leadership

Maintain a strong culture of regulatory compliance, risk management, and ethical conduct.
Provide oversight of operational controls, governance practices, and supervisory frameworks to safeguard clients, employees, and the organization.
Partner with Compliance, Risk, and Legal stakeholders to identify and mitigate business risks while supporting sustainable growth.

Strategic Execution & Change Leadership

Translate enterprise priorities into actionable market plans and measurable business outcomes.
Lead transformational initiatives and change efforts that enhance business performance, advisor productivity, and client outcomes.
Leverage data and performance metrics to monitor results, identify opportunities, and drive continuous improvement

Qualifications

10+ years of progressive leadership experience within Private Wealth, Wealth Management, Investment Management, Banking, or a related financial services environment.
Demonstrated success leading high-performing advisor teams and driving business growth, client acquisition, and market expansion.
Deep knowledge of wealth management, advisor practice management, and the high-net-worth client segment.
Strong understanding of the regulatory, compliance, and risk management framework governing the wealth management industry.
Broad knowledge of financial services, including investment management, wealth planning, banking, and credit solutions for affluent and high-net-worth clients.
Proven ability to influence stakeholders, develop talent, lead through change, and execute strategic initiatives.
Exceptional communication, relationship management, and leadership capabilities.
University degree or equivalent combination of education and experience; advanced industry credentials such as CSC, CIM, CFP, ETI, MBA, CPA, or equivalent are considered an asset.
Must meet all applicable licensing, registration, and certification requirements.

This role offers a highly competitive total rewards package, including substantial performance-based incentive opportunities aligned with the growth and success of the market.

Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As a Director of Strategic Partnerships
at Via, you will be the face and voice of Via for our partners, both internally and externally. You'll build genuine, durable relationships with the cities and operators working to deliver better transportation for their communities, while owning the commercial outcomes that come with it — from complex renewals to service expansions. Our Partner Success team is made up of talented, collaborative people who are passionate about making public transit better, and at Via, the work we do together translates into real impact for the people who depend on it every day.

About the Role:

Own a portfolio of complex, high-value partner relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for executive city and agency leadership and setting the standard for how we show up at that level
Act as a trusted advisor and consultant to partners at the most senior levels, translating their ideas and community needs into revenue opportunities and driving decisions that shape service outcomes
Build and steward deep, long-term relationships with partners, acting as a strategic peer to senior leadership and spotting opportunities for service growth and revenue generation
Use service performance data to set the strategic direction for each partnership, ensuring decisions on quality, efficiency, and growth are grounded in evidence
Independently lead multi-year and highly complex contract renewals and service expansions, navigating high-stakes negotiations with executive stakeholders to increase year-on-year revenue
Champion new products and capabilities internally, influencing Via's roadmap and advocating for partners to facilitate the expansion of each partner's service size and scope

About You:

10+ years of relevant work experience in a client-facing role, with a track record of owning and growing strategic accounts independently at the most senior levels
Fluency in French and English is required for frequent client interaction.
Quantitatively inclined and data savvy; you use complex data sets to drive strategic decisions and influence senior stakeholders both internally and externally
An entrepreneurial relationship builder who brings clarity and confidence to highly complex, politically sensitive situations, turning them into opportunities to deepen trust
A reliable, motivated self-starter who shapes the way things are done and sets a standard others aspire to
A natural leader in every sense — someone whose judgment, presence, and way of operating raises the quality of the work and the people around them, regardless of title

Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable
Salary Range: $160,000-$200,000 CAD

A Group RRSP & DPSP with a company match.
Standard and extended job-protected parental leave options, with company-paid health benefits fully maintained during your leave
Additional wellness benefits (including 24/7 virtual medicine, mental health practitioner coverage, EAP, and other wellness perks)
20 days of paid time off (PTO) annually, plus paid provincial statutory holidays
